EvidenceThatWouldChangePolicy: Any shortfall in contractual cash coverage or failure to ring-fence Delta coupons
Action: Restore funding coverage before taking growth risk

EvidenceThatWouldChangePolicy: A sustained inflation assumption that materially raises the required CAGR beyond the policy's defensible return range
Action: Reassess feasible target, growth risk and trade-off explicitly

EvidenceThatWouldChangePolicy: A forecast deterioration beyond the utility indifference threshold in Table_G3
Action: Re-evaluate the recommended versus rejected allocation using the predeclared rule

EvidenceThatWouldChangePolicy: Trustees formally define a loss metric/horizon that the current allocation violates
Action: Re-optimize under the newly specified risk preference, documenting the mandate change

EvidenceThatWouldChangePolicy: A holding breaches eligibility, concentration limits, or the no-borrowing/no-short/no-derivatives mandate
Action: Rebalance or replace only under the governing policy and document the change
